rows.what_the_ink_shows: The page consists of handwritten complexes and arrow diagrams. At the top are boxed C: omega -> omega^(p) and Pi: g^(p) — g; paired triangular diagrams contain omega, its p twists, C, and Delta*. Across the middle the ink explicitly reads « Delta*(G) complexe cristallin avec F,V, filtration à facteurs » followed by boxed phi*(Q), phi*(P). The complete page also shows M, M^(p), F and V diagrams. No printed SGA 4 XII or Lipman typescript and no editorial list of scan numbers appears on this page. Evidence: crops/8_scan002_L746_complexes_upper.jpg and crops/8_scan002_L747_crystalline_filtrations.jpg, with the full scan inspected.

All existing diagram code and doubt marks remain unchanged.

Below it the ink writes phi epsilon = F_S, with a cancelled mark before the live F_S and « frobenius absolu » underneath. To the right the text calls Delta*(G) a complexe cristallin avec F,V and gives filtrations with phi*(Q), phi*(P), then P,Q. This is the positive scan-2 locus cited by the correction, and it is already represented in page.tex. The editorial list « cote 8, scans 19-20, 27-31, 37, 51, 61-72 » is absent. Evidence: crops/8_scan002_L747_sites_and_frobenius.jpg and crops/8_scan002_L747_crystalline_filtrations.jpg.
rows.note: No manuscript change. Category d concerns the editorial scan list, not the site diagram: the phi/epsilon pair and written phi epsilon = F_S are present on scan 2 and have been directly rechecked. This page itself supplies that positive location. The source's claims about scans 4–5, 19–20, 27–31, 37, 51 and 61–72, and its assertion that these are the only crystalline-site loci in cote 8, go beyond this check and are not independently confirmed. The written equation is read as ink; no mathematical proof is claimed. Preserve the existing tikz-cd site diagram, cancellation and all other notation. Main-reader cross-location check: cote 8 scan 002 visibly presents the paired site maps and phi epsilon = F_S; scan 004 contains the crystalline-complex material and related maps; scan 019 is the actual Tribu n. 66 integration sheet. The reports and retained crops for those pages document these local distinctions. No claim is made about absent or unsupplied leaves of the proposed range.
